verdict.rationale: The B300 is a GPU, so whether it supports DLSS/FSR-style upscaling and frame generation is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence documents only data-center AI training and inference (FP4/FP8 throughput, LLM deployment, DGX systems) and never mentions DLSS, FSR, frame generation, or game support.

support.subject: As a gamer, AI upscaling and frame generation are supported on this card — the DLSS or FSR generation is documented for this part, with broad game support
